acceptanceCriteria: The pre-commit pass refuses the same verify commands the post-commit pass refuses, with a test.
The refusal names the offending command and the accepted form.
body: Found in lane H (V1-1116, PR beamfall/corvint#745). A verify file whose go test command used `-run '^(A|B)$'` passed the pre-commit dogfood-change pass and was refused only on the post-commit bind pass, after the CEM commit, forcing a rebind. Expected: the same validation on both passes, so the refusal arrives before any evidence commit. Exact refusal text is in lane H's transcript; reproduce with a verify file containing an anchored alternation -run pattern.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#758 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/758; merged 55aa6bb9, ancestor of batch merge); on main at 00dd220753973cd7eb332b3b7572db4a2ca60265 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/789). Tests named in the PR: internal/dogfoodflow, internal/trace verify-command tests; cmd/corvint TestDogfoodChange*. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: dogfood-change accepts a DOGFOOD_VERIFY_FILE `-run '^(...)$'` command pre-commit but refuses it only on the post-commit pass
